verses.text_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ

translations.text: And when the stars fall, scattering,
And when the seas are erupted
And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,
A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

verses.text_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Yaaa ayyuhal insaaanu maa gharraka bi Rabbikal kareem

translations.text: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

verses.text_uthmani: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
verses.transliteration: Feee ayye sooratim maa shaaa'a rakkabak

translations.text: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
No! But you deny the Recompense.
And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
And never therefrom will they be absent.

verses.transliteration: Wa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen

translations.text: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Summa maaa adraaka maa Yawmud Deen

translations.text: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ
verses.transliteration: Yawma laa tamliku nafsul linafsin shai'anw walamru yawma'izil lillaah

translations.text: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
